opening.argument: The promotion directs viewers to a featured site, instructs them to provide whatever information is requested, and ties submission to a purported free Walmart gift card. The displayed claim-and-register flow includes a Facebook login with email or phone and password fields, followed by a form requesting date of birth and gender. The process is also qualified by a purchase-requirements notice, while the final page says to check email to redeem rather than showing a delivered card. The description further presents generating free gift cards for resale as a possible use. These features establish a low-barrier reward or asset-acquisition scheme built around credentials and personal details, although the frames do not establish that information was submitted or that a gift card was delivered.
